purpose: Text-free poster backgrounds shown in place of the YouTube player for commentary videos on the Ukraine desk (issue #71, sub-issue #84). The page sets the channel name, a 'Commentary' label and the play button as live HTML over the dark left side, then loads the privacy-enhanced player only after a tap.
source: Drawn in code (soft gradient fields and grain) by an AI assistant for Infinity Enterprises. No text, photos, channel logos, profile pictures or faces.
alt: Decorative. Use alt=""; the channel name and play button are HTML text.
text_zone: Left 55% of each card stays near-black (background luminance at or below 0.022, 90th percentile) so ivory #f4efe6 text measures at least 12.8:1 and #cfc8bd labels at least 8.8:1 there.
